question: Pandit Rajendra Gangani is associated with which classical dance of India?
solution:
Correct Answer **Kathak dance**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Kathak dance

__
 
• ​One of the eight primary styles of Indian classical dance is kathak.
 
• It is an Uttar Pradesh classical dancing style.
 
• The storytellers or itinerant bards known as Kathakars in ancient northern India are often credited as the creators of Kathak.
 
• The Vedic Sanskrit words Katha, which means "story," and Kathakar, which means "the one who tells a story" or "to do with stories," are the roots of the word Kathak.
 
• Traveling Kathakars used dance, songs, and music to transmit tales from the great epics and ancient mythology. 
 
• Kathak dancers use intricate footwork, flexible body movements, and, most importantly, expressive face expressions to convey a variety of stories.

 
• Pandit Rajendra Gangani is a renowned Kathak dancer trained in the Jaipur Gharāna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Odissi Dance:

 
• Odissi is a folk dance form of Odisha.

 
• This is a delicate dance backed by soothing lyrics and Is similar to Bharatnatyam in terms of Mudras and Expressions. 
 
• The cave of Udayagiri-Khandagiri provides the earliest example of Odissi.
 
• It was primarily practiced by Maharis under patrons of Jain King Kheravela.
 
• "Mobile Sculpture" includes two major postures: 
 
 
• Tribhanga - The body is deflected at the neck, torso, and knees.
 
• Chowk - A position imitating a square.
 
 
 
• Indrani Rehman, Charles Fabri, Guru Pankaj Charan Das, and Kelu Charan Mohapatra are some of the famous artists of Odissi dance.
